In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in the rat, the ribosomal RNA of the liver constitutes about 90% of the total RNA, and that this percentage does not change significantly with the nutritional status of the organism.

, in the rat, the ribosomal RNA constitutes the bulk of the RNA of liver and of Novikoff hepatomas and that, under the conditions studied, the total RNA content is not a valid index of ribosome content.
ribosomes are the major RNA fraction of rat liver cells and that the total RNA of the cell can serve as an approximate measure for the ribosome content.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RNA per cell of the Novikoff tumor, relative to the RNA per cell in the liver of a fed rat, is 1.5, whereas the number of ribosomes per cell is the same.

, in rat liver, about 90% of RNA is ribosomal, and, in Novikoff hepatomas, about 85% of RNA is of this type, and that the RNA of both tissues can be considered to consist almost entirely of ribosomal material.
ribosomal RNA constitutes about 90% of total RNA of normal and of neoplastic rat liver.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ribosome content of a tissue can be accurately estimated from the RNA content, and that the latter is an appropriate measure of the amount of ribosomal precursor RNA.
, for the rat liver and hepatoma examined, the ribosomal RNA fraction of total is constant, and that this value can be used as an approximation of the ribosomal content of other mammalian tissues.
the RNA content of liver and hepatoma can be used as a reliable index of the ribosomal content of these tissues, and, by inference, of other mammalian cells.
